**Summary of Work So Far:**

**Completed:**
- Read the entire `parse.py` source file (1318 lines) - understood the structure including Parser class, Result class, type converters, date/time handling, etc.
- Read most of `test_parse.py` (about 800 lines out of 973+) - identified test patterns and expectations

**Pending Requirements:**
- [R1] Add 'letters' format specifier matching only alphabetic characters (a-z, A-Z)
- [R2] Add `__contains__` method to Result class
- [R3] Raise error when braces are not fully enclosed
- [R4] Fix FixedTzOffset timezone offset parsing (Bug 92)
- [R5] Support Fortran-formatted floating-point numbers
- [R6] Proper hex/binary/octal integer conversion with automatic base detection
- [R7] Replace lambdas/inner functions with functors for picklability
- [R8] Make findall() honor case_sensitive parameter
- [R9] Left/center-aligned searches consume input up to next space
- [R10] Add slice access to Result objects

**Next Steps:**
1. Read remaining test_parse.py to understand edge cases
2. Implement all 10 requirements in parse.py
3. Run existing tests (`python -m pytest test_parse.py` or `python test_parse.py`)
4. Write STATUS.json with probabilities

**Current Status:** Ready to begin implementation after reviewing remaining tests.
